steps.title: Write a game
steps.body: Everything together: start with 0 coins and a hint, each chest use adds a coin with a sound, three coins sends won, won plays the reward scene once, and the end of the scene shows “You win!”. Replace the whole program with this.

steps.title: Play your game
steps.body: Press Play, walk to the chest and press E three times. Your code runs exactly as you wrote it.

steps.title: You can code Brick Worlds
steps.body: You've used every part of the language: events, variables, if/else, and/or/not, wait, once, gates, random, world actions, sound, screens, scenes and debugging. Help › Help guide › Coding guide and Logic reference list every event and action with its code. The AI builder (✦) can also write logic for you — it shows you the code it writes before you accept it.
